{"code":"import nanosurf

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()  # or .C3000() or .CX(), or .CoreAFM()

# Set scan parameters
scan = application.Scan
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # [m]
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # [m]
scan.Scantime = 0.55  # [s] time per line
scan.Points = 256  # points per line
scan.Lines = 256  # lines per frame
scan.CenterPosX = 5e-6  # [m]
scan.CenterPosY = 5e-6  # [m]
scan.SlopeX = 0.0  # degree
scan.SlopeY = 0.0  # degree
scan.Overscan = 0  # [%]
scan.Rotation = 0  # degree

# Set Z controller parameters
zcontrol = application.ZController
zcontrol.SetPoint = 1  # [%/V]
zcontrol.PGain = 3100
zcontrol.IGain = 3500

# Start scan
try:
    application.StartScan()
    # Wait for scan to complete
    while application.IsScanning:
        pass
    # Attempt to save the image using a different method
    image_path = 'C:/Users/Admin/Desktop/corral/mat-agent-bench/tasks/afm/src/afm/gpt_4o_brief/enviroment/subtasks_1/afm_image.bmp'
    application.SaveImageAs(image_path, format='bmp')
except Exception as e:
    image_path = f'Scan failed: {str(e)}'

image_path"}
